arguments.sql: SELECT products.line AS Linea, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Importo, DATE_FORMAT(orders.order_date, '%Y') AS OrderYear FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE YEAR(orders.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY products.line, OrderYear;

SELECT products.line AS Linea, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Importo, LEFT(orders.order_date, 4) AS OrderYear FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE YEAR(orders.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY products.line, OrderYear;
